landing.eyebrow: Pet care, with peace of mind
landing.title: Everything good for your pet, within reach.
landing.subtitle: Health records, veterinary bookings and emergency support — helping you care for your pet at every stage.
landing.ownersBody: Track vaccines, medication and care in a health record you can share.
landing.clinicsBody: Reach nearby pet owners, manage appointments and verify your clinic.
landing.sosBody: PawCare helps connect you with nearby clinics and share information for remote triage. It does not diagnose or treat.
landing.trustBody: You control who can access your pet’s record. Only clinics you authorize can see medical information.
landing.faqOneAnswer: No. PawCare supports connections and remote triage; it does not diagnose or replace an in-person visit.
landing.faqTwoAnswer: Yes. View and revoke access in Privacy settings.

admin.metricsWindow: Rolling 30-day metrics from recorded platform data.
admin.obsDescription: Operational signals over the rolling 30-day window. Alerts require the minimum sample count shown below.
admin.obsFirstPingP95: SOS time to first clinic ping · p95
admin.obsErrorTrackingDescription: Server errors emit JSON logs with request IDs. SOS spans use an opaque trace ID across request, ping, accept and session events.
admin.obsPrivacy: Logs contain timing, outcomes and opaque IDs only; no pet, owner, symptom or message content.
admin.obsUptimeDescription: A scheduled GitHub Actions check requests the public liveness endpoint every five minutes when PAWCARE_UPTIME_URL is configured.
admin.obsWindow: Demo page is platform-admin only. Thresholds: SOS first-ping p95 >30 seconds, dispatch failures ≥10%, AI errors/fallbacks ≥5%; each alert requires at least 20 samples.
admin.obsProductPrivacy: No user-level identities or health content are shown. Owner denominators use cohorts of 14+ days; retention uses owners created 31–60 days ago.
admin.reasonPrompt: Enter a reason for this action (at least 5 characters).
admin.stepUpRequired: Verify your authenticator again in Security settings before continuing.

admin.mfaSecret: If scanning is unavailable, enter this setup key in your authenticator app

admin.mfaSetupFailed: Could not verify the authenticator code. Try again.
admin.reauthDescription: Enter a current authenticator code to confirm your identity for sensitive actions.
admin.verificationOpen: Use the Verification requests page to inspect private documents and record a checklist decision.
admin.featureFlagsNote: Flags are switched off unless explicitly enabled by an authorized administrator.
